verdict.rationale: Browser Use ships an open-source Python library that runs a local agent from your own code with any LLM, and a community user confirms running it locally against their own browser profile. However, the docs present this library as separate from the Cloud Agent and Browser APIs. The cloud-only features (hardened stealth Chromium, residential proxies, automatic CAPTCHA solving, saved profiles) have no evidenced self-hostable equivalent. Missing for 10: self-hostable parity with the cloud agent and browser infrastructure, explicit self-hosting/deployment docs, and an evidenced license or open-source status of the full stack.
